why: the desk asked for stock-index CFDs as a third class after the FX/metals model runs had started. P1 and P2 stay as frozen on FX + metals. INDEX is frozen here, before any INDEX build or model run, with its own mirrors of P1 and P2 as secondaries under Benjamini-Hochberg
everything_else: as fxml_rule.json and its two amendments: targets, features (first-frozen set for the registered models; Q, E and O in the ablation and importance), models, tuning budget, conformal layers, reporting in three parts (skill on walks, real-minus-walk behavioural skill, the after-cost trade)

broker_csv.source: the lab's broker bar exports data/deep2/<name>_1h_broker.csv.gz (the same broker; not in MT5BT_DB); 4h and 1d resampled from 1h on the UTC grid
broker_csv.note: the DB holds no other index CFD; the 15m exports in data/fine cover the same four

universe.class: INDEX, reported apart from FX and METAL

split.history: the broker's index bars start 2024-01-22 at every timeframe, so 2024-01-01 leaves no discovery
split.rule: split at the midpoint of the index span: discovery = labels resolved before 2025-06-01, confirmation = bars from 2025-06-01 (about 16 months each); fit / calibration = the first 80% / last 20% of discovery as in the main rule
split.caveat: 1d has about 340 discovery bars a series: thin, reported but not leaned on

costs.spread: per bar: max(the spread floor, the median of the series' bar spread column at that UTC hour) x point, so session-dependent spreads are charged where the bars carry them. Floor: R.spread_floor for the MT5BT_DB indices; for France 40 and Hong Kong 50 the median tick spread in data/research.db (fra40, hk50); Europe 50 and US Small Cap 2000 have no spread source and are forecast but left out of the trade translation
costs.swap: INDEX trades also pay swap: the broker's swap_long / swap_short (swap_mode 5, annual % of the current price, / 360 a night, x3 on the Friday rollover as swap_rollover3days = 5) for every 17:00 New York rollover the trade is held across; CSV indices use the median rate of the MT5BT_DB indices. Trades are reported with and without swap
costs.slippage: 0.05 ATR on stop exits, as the main rule

walks: hour-profiled walks (synth.matched_profiled): each series' own UTC hour-of-day volatility profile and its own overnight / weekend jumps, on its real timestamps, 256 sub-steps a bar, in log price. iid: no clustering; GARCH: the profile times a GARCH(1,1) variance (alpha 0.08, beta 0.9). The FX / metals walks inside the index build are the main rule's walks (same seeds)

features_added.session_x: every name starts with x_. Hours since the latest US cash open (09:30 New York) and since the latest EU cash open (09:00 Frankfurt), each at the bar's close, local time with daylight saving; in US regular hours (09:30-16:00 New York) and in EU regular hours (09:00-17:30 Frankfurt) at the bar's close; whether the bar contains the US / EU cash open. All are clock facts known at t. For 1d they are constant and carry nothing
features_added.index_pca: ix_*: the cross-index factor model (the main rule's rolling PCA with the 11 indices as panel members); pc_*: every index's loadings on and residual against the FX / metals panel factors (the 17 main instruments as members, the indices projected)
features_added.registered_models_use: the first-frozen features plus x_ and ix_

registered_secondary.I-P1: INDEX 1h rvk QLIKE, confirmation: tuned HGB against log-HAR-RV, (a) interval below 0 and (b) beyond the GARCH walk, as P1
registered_secondary.I-P2: INDEX 4h sign1 AUC of the frozen best model against its walk-trained twins: AUC >= 0.510 and real-minus-walk interval above 0 against both, as P2
registered_secondary.bh: both join the BH family with every other INDEX secondary (q = 0.10)

trade_translation: the main rule's frozen conformal-set trade, run on INDEX as a diagnostic unless I-P2 passes
